scope: Root quantum/theory-context source audit; not whole-paper validation

references.source_location: Original STOC paper/abstract; ACM DOI10.1145/237814.237866
references.supports: Unstructured quantum search query scaling
references.limits: Query count excludes reversible implementation cost; not a structured knapsack lower bound.

references.source_location: Section3.1 and Theorem3.5
references.supports: Black-box and random-oracle lower-bound context
references.limits: Theorem3.5 concerns random-oracle NP and time o(2^(n/2)); it does not rule out structure-exploiting knapsack algorithms.

references.source_location: Section2, Theorem3; arXiv journal reference/related DOI; AMS volume305 cover
references.supports: Amplitude amplification using A and its inverse
references.limits: Theorem3 assumes measurement-free A, success probability a>0; expected O(1/sqrt(a)); zero-solution handling requires more than that statement. Publisher cover gives Quantum Computation and Information despite arXiv journal-reference title discrepancy.

references.source_location: Author technical-report abstract; author-institution published record https://researchers.mq.edu.au/en/publications/implementing-pure-adaptive-search-with-grovers-quantum-algorithm/
references.supports: Grover-based implementation of pure adaptive search
references.limits: Conditional objective/domain assumptions; not unrestricted polynomial knapsack optimization. Published2003JOTA116(3)517--529, DOI10.1023/A:1023061218864.

references.source_location: Abstract and original1996 submission/revision history
references.supports: Quantum minimum finding as optimization background
references.limits: Cited as original preprint, not an invented journal publication; no theorem transplanted into our oracle.

references.source_location: Author-posted abstract, metadata and official BibTeX
references.supports: Quantum subset-sum algorithms using Johnson-graph walks and representation methods
references.limits: The source describes heuristic cost; cite the verified expanded ePrint rather than guessing conference-version details. This is exact-target subset sum, not arbitrary weight/value optimization.

references.source_location: Publisher metadata, abstract and paper opening
references.supports: Quantum subset-sum algorithms under random-instance/heuristic assumptions
references.limits: No current-best claim and no worst-case general-knapsack exponent. Exact proceedings pagination5:1--5:15.

references.source_location: Published abstract and official BibTeX
references.supports: Active/passive QRAM assumptions and costs
references.limits: Does not prove all quantum-addressable memory impossible; circuit QRAM can help. Updated2023preprint to Quantum9,1922(2025).

references.source_location: Abstract, accepted-at-QCE statement and related DOI
references.supports: QTG state preparation with Grover-mixer QAOA; finite-depth evidence and eventual optimal-sampling result
references.limits: Not all QTG uses are QAOA; do not claim no guarantees whatsoever. DOI10.1109/QCE65121.2025.00011; no unverified page range inserted.

references.source_location: Statement of results and oracle model
references.supports: Quantum branch-and-bound query framework
references.limits: Monotone cost/bounding oracle, depth and precision assumptions matter. The result is not a free-oracle runtime bound and is not simply sqrt(T)*d in all models. Old body theorem remains on hold.

references.source_location: Algorithm description and asymptotic-depth discussion
references.supports: QAOA variational framework
references.limits: Do not claim all QAOA lacks guarantees; source has specified approximation/limit results.

references.source_location: Abstract and official BibTeX
references.supports: Grover adaptive search for constrained polynomial binary optimization
references.limits: Search is not variational QAOA. Source discusses oracle construction and conditional comparison with brute force, not blanket practical advantage. Quantum5,428(2021).

references.source_location: Author full text; Quantum2,79 metadata
references.supports: Noise/depth context
references.limits: No evidence for this project's device experiments, a four-item boundary or its implementation-specific mitigation claims.

references.source_location: Official Qiskit BibTeX; Aer README citation link
references.supports: Software attribution to Quantum computing with Qiskit,2024
references.limits: Citation is not evidence for device execution or experiment results. Actual package versions belong in later methods revision.

references.source_location: Section3.2 heuristic discussion, Sections4--5 alternative algorithms and memory tradeoffs; publisher DOI metadata
references.supports: Specific walk-update heuristic issue and subsequent alternatives
references.limits: Do not label every subset-sum method unsound or every variant QRAQM-dependent. Correct ASIACRYPT2020,LNCS12492,633--666, DOI10.1007/978-3-030-64834-3_22.

references.source_location: Publisher full paper, Theorems1.1/1.2
references.supports: Quantum backtracking query framework
references.limits: Detection and witness recovery have distinct statements. No full gate-model LP walk follows merely from a citation. ToC14(15)1--24(2018), DOI10.4086/toc.2018.v014a015.

references.source_location: Article title/authors, abstract and hybrid model
references.supports: Classical B&B with quantum annealing for integer linear problems
references.limits: Correct authors Sanavio,Tignone,Ercolessi; Entropy26(4),345(2024), DOI10.3390/e26040345. Oldarxiv2403.09560 is a different DFT paper and is removed.

references.source_location: Sections3.1/4, Eq16--20, floor-pruning rule; Section5 experimental scope; publisher CiteThisArticle
references.supports: Finite multiplier-set bounds and integer pruning are prior art; quantum annealing hybrid
references.limits: Their sign convention u<=0 maps to our nonnegative lambda=-u; local residual capacity maps to their subproblem W. No claim their model certifies our bank or circuit. Large instances ran root-bound calculations only. Online2024; actual issue is AnnalsOR364,2111--2126(2026).

references.source_location: Publisher abstract and bibliographic header
references.supports: Lagrangian duality in constrained quantum optimization, comparison with QUBO
references.limits: Different adiabatic/fault-tolerant framework; does not establish this bank's correctness or novelty. PRR7,023305(2025), authors EinarGabbassov,GiliRosenberg,ArturScherer.

references.source_location: Publisher abstract/metadata, arxiv1908.11291 author version
references.supports: Concrete implementation of quantum backtracking and resource accounting
references.limits: CSP graph coloring/SAT, not a full implementation of this LP oracle. Updated to SOFSEM2020,LNCS12011,597--606; key retains historical2019identifier only.
